data.answer:
The 2024 study’s best patent-scope classifier was the **MLP classifier**, scoring **0.780 on F1** for “broader versus not broader”, using first and all claims.[1] F1 is the harmonic mean of precision and recall—not percentage accuracy.[2]

The three-way model actually deployed for the main analysis classified patents as narrower, similar or broader and achieved an **F1 score of 0.772**.[3]
